prompts: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Input image is the approved FULL GAME UI concept, only its UPPER RIGHT TURN HEADER is the design reference. Produce a production-ready isolated transparent PNG asset of that horizontal bronze-and-black turn/control HEADER. Faithfully recreate the existing approved header's narrow worn old dark brass branches, small scroll corners, black leather/metal inset, asymmetrical left pointed projection, delicate weathering, edge-integrated style. NO LOGBOOK, no cards, no environment, no other panels. NO TEXT, numbers, labels, icons or astrology imagery. The header will contain live text on the LEFT 45% and two separate circular BUTTON ASSETS overlaid side by side on the RIGHT 55%. Therefore OMIT THE TWO BUTTON DISCS AND THEIR RINGS completely in this export, leave that right area an uninterrupted dark inset bounded by the SAME unified top and bottom brass rails. Do not draw ring placeholders. Preserve enough room for two equal circles; no vertical divider if it crowds the circles. Full external header silhouette native width:height approx 3:1, not a thin 4:1 pill. Top/right thornlike metal ornament slight outgrowth as in selected reference, more substantial at far left. Dark subdued, tarnished bronze not shiny gold; realistic fine metal work not cartoon flat outline. Completely frontal UI, no perspective skew. Entire header fully visible, small padding all around. Deliver genuinely TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the object; no checkerboard pattern painted into RGB, no white/gray backdrop, no exterior shadow plane, no annotations. Target isolated header around 1800x600 visible pixels with modest transparent margin.

Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Input image is the approved FULL GAME UI mockup. Extract/recreate ONLY the PAPER LOGBOOK from the UPPER RIGHT area as a standalone production UI sprite. Match the approved B version closely: weathered grey-tan parchment with fine printed ornamental margin lines, layered uneven page edges, very dark brown old leather binding visible on LEFT, two small leather straps/bronze clasp attachments projecting slightly over the LEFT margin, antique book hinges and aged page stains. The writing surface is pale enough for near-black live text, muted grey-brown NOT bright cream/yellow/white. Complete intact journal front viewed directly face-on, native width:height about 0.72 (portrait rectangle), slight organic irregular page contour. The page is anchored by its book binding, not a hanging fabric flag. Include no upper turn header, no controls, no cards and NO TENTACLES; the game already has a tentacle layer to overlap the lower right corner. REMOVE ALL CHARACTERS, title, letters, numbers and pseudo-writing from the reference; leave a generously clean blank writing area on the right 72% of the paper (fine faint wear is okay), with no drawn divider line across the writing area because HTML will add one. Left 20% may be binding, clasps; lower and right edges must remain subtle. Preserve the paper/material tone and realistic ornament of the approved reference, no extra heavy shiny brass frame, no plastic, no cartoony look. Entire object uncut, about 1080x1500 visible pixels, modest transparent margin. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside silhouette; do not paint a checkerboard into RGB. No decorative floor/background, no environment, no text of any kind.

Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Input image is the selected full game concept. Recreate exactly ONE of the upper-right circular control button faces as a reusable standalone EMPTY button disc. Same muted worn aged-brass rim and charcoal almost-black slightly teal inset as the PAUSE/SETTINGS buttons in this B reference. The brass ring must be thin realistic finely worn sculptural metal, with small subtle outside fasteners, restrained low brightness matching the dark game's trim. NO PAUSE BARS, NO GEAR, no icon, no symbols or lettering; the game places icons over this shared identical base. Perfectly circular disc, front-on, no perspective, balanced symmetrical rim, minimal outer protrusions equally balanced so the visible circle reads centered. Not oval. Not a clock/astrolabe, no stars, no new inner rings or functional markings. One centered circle, square image with small equal transparent margin. Transparent alpha background genuinely, no baked checkerboard, no white/gray plane. Detailed at about 800x800 visible pixels.
